Core area (apply). No existing change restores an earlier theme: theming-audit is append-only evidence. Core area (apply). No change or code schedules a theme change for a date.

Core area (catalogue). The only additive path is uploading your own file; no gallery to browse and install from exists. The upstream-freshness non-goal (no auto-download by the background job) does not cover an admin choosing to install a set.
